title: Chapter 601
text:
"The defense of this fortress is not bad. It's Grade A equipment."

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows, and a hint of excitement flashed across his eyes.

Carroll's information popped up on the interface. His level was higher than Han Xiao's, and some of his attributes and skills were filled with question marks.

Han Xiao was not surprised by this. He was only level 142, and even a normal Grade A equipment was higher than him.

The defense of the Heavy Fortress was very high, but it was not to the point where it was indestructible. However, Han Xiao did not want to fight head-on. As a Virtual Mechanic, he still had some professional integrity. Without saying anything, he started Virtual Intrusion and passed the control of the Buddha's Palm to Philip.

"Philip, play with him. Block his cannon fire. Don't let him kill my army."

"Order confirmed. Starting execution, hum …"

The Buddha's Palm slapped out again, and a propulsive flame suddenly shot out from the bottom of the Heavy Fortress. The heavy fortress instantly rose into the air, dodging this attack and moving quickly in the sky.

This was a flying fortress.

The Buddha's Palm chased after the Heavy Fortress and performed a duet in midair.

Han Xiao focused on Virtual Intrusion, and the Mech Legion on both sides fought fiercely.

The five Mech Legion that were equipped with brand new equipment had their lethality increased by more than just a little. The blue-green plasma cannons exploded steel, the heat cannons melted metal, and the Space Distortion bombs were like small black holes, creating a vortex of distortion wherever they hit. There was no need to even mention the small thermonuclear mines. These were all cute little mushroom plants.

The Cube Army was formed into three types of troops. The normal-sized Cube Robots, the small combined mechanical soldiers that were half the height of a human, and the small giant-like robots. Each of them had their own advantages. Some were nimble, and some were heavy.

It was as if the G-2 Heavy Armored Cavalry were unstoppable, slaughtering their way in and out of the enemy's formation. All sorts of cold close-combat weapons crushed countless enemies into pieces, and like a piece of eraser, they constantly drew blank spaces on the battlefield.

The performance of Han Xiao's Mech Legion was obviously a level higher than the standard mechanical soldiers controlled by Carroll. They could be considered half an elite.

The killing efficiency was like harvesting, and Carroll's mechanical army fell one after another.

As soon as they clashed, Han Xiao's Mech Legion had the upper hand.

However, the reinforcements came in an endless stream, and they couldn't kill them all. More and more corpses piled up on the ground. Carlos was determined to use up all of Han Xiao's assets. He didn't even direct his troops to attack Han Xiao. He only focused on cutting off Han Xiao's wings. He didn't care even if it was three for one.

Han Xiao was not without losses either. The five regular legions were also slowly losing their combat strength.

The mechanical soldiers that occasionally approached Han Xiao were either shot to pieces by the Watcher Instrument or smashed to pieces by the Oathkeepers.

This kind of war of attrition was equivalent to a bladder game.

"How long are they going to fight?" One of the vanguard officials couldn't help but ask.

Malekith shook his head. "It will take at least a few hours."

At this time, another figure jumped up. When the other vanguard officials looked over, they were all shocked.

"Second Brother, you're here too!"

"Yes, the chief asked me to come and take a look." The newcomer was a tall and skinny humanoid species. He was tall and looked like a refreshing stream in the Bloodshed Land that was filled with muscular men.

This person's nickname was Jaeger. There were different styles in the Pugilist class. Not only did he have a violent style, but he also walked the path of the High Agility Weapon Style. He was the second of the eight vanguard officials, ranking second.

The eight vanguard officials also had different ranks. The chief vanguard was the eldest, the most experienced, and the strongest. He had always been personally taught by Heber and was Grade A +. He was also a training maniac and spent almost all of his free time in the gravity training room. The difference between him and the others was obvious. The second Jaeger was also very strong. The two of them usually carried out more dangerous missions and were very elusive. Their sudden appearance at this time shocked the other vanguard officials.

Looking at the battle situation, Jaeger quickly analyzed the situation and slowly said, "Black Star seems to have the upper hand on the surface, but he's actually in a passive position. Carroll wants to fight a protracted battle, and Black Star has to end the battle quickly. If he can't break through Carroll's defense quickly, the situation will take a turn for the worse when his troops suffer too many losses."

"I think so too." Malekith nodded and paused. "However, the current situation is very good. Carroll has the location advantage, and his combat power is also very high. Black Star's chances are slim."

"Carroll … is not bad, right?"

Jaeger nodded lightly, acknowledging Carroll's strength.

On the other side, the three Klent officials also arrived and climbed up the building to watch the battle. After asking the bystanders around them, they finally understood the cause and effect of the battle.

"Black Star actually dared to openly challenge one of Bloodshed Land's officers in their territory? How daring. "

Ralph was quite surprised.

"He's taking revenge for Ames, right? A current officer of Floating Dragon challenging a former traitor. How meaningful is that?" The Klent official chuckled.

Ralph nodded and turned to look at Ames, who was not far away. He realized that Ames was staring at the battle with a focused expression.

…

Rumble —

The cannon fire was endless, and the battle was still going on.

Both sides continued to fight, and the situation gradually reached a stalemate.

Suddenly, Carroll's heavy fortress sped up and shook off the Buddha's Palm. It suddenly started to change shape.

The heavy machinery broke down and turned into mechanical parts before being reassembled. At the same time, Carroll threw out a bunch of compressed orbs, which expanded into new parts. Countless parts quickly merged together.

In the blink of an eye, the parts that filled the sky formed a large humanoid mechanical suit that was thirty to forty meters tall!

Large Battle Mech, [Giant Soldier — Ship Destroyer]!

The Ship Destroyer Giant Soldier was humanoid in shape. It had two hands and two legs, but it did not have a head. Its top was the conical end of its torso. Its appearance was black and green, and its thick armor covered its joints and vital points. Its body was wide at the top and narrow at the bottom. Its legs were equipped with thrusters and track wheels, and its body was filled with all kinds of weapons. On its back was a pair of steel-like thrusters.

To describe it more down-to-earth, this thing was like an inverted green trash can with arms, legs, and wings.

Carroll looked down at Han Xiao coldly before sitting in the cockpit at the center of the torso.

Bang!

After the Ship Destroyer landed, it rolled agilely, and its huge body shook the ground. Then, it squatted on the ground and swung the Heat Fusion Chainsword in one hand. The armor on the other hand opened up and turned into a thick and heavy alloy shield.

The Heavy Mech Faction relied on all kinds of large and giant machines to fight. This kind of large mechanical suit was usually called the Giant Soldier Mech. Its thirty to forty meters tall body was comparable to some small spaceships.

With such a large body, more power structures or energy cores could be stuffed into it. Its performance was very strong, and it could fight in the universe directly. It was equivalent to a more flexible galactic vehicle.

Virtual Mechanics participated in the universe war through invasions, while Heavy Mech Faction could create such a Giant Soldier to fight against battleships.

The Ship Destroyer Giant Soldier held the alloy shield and charged forward. Its huge feet made the ground shake, and the shield smashed onto the Buddha's Palm. The huge force knocked the Buddha's Palm to the side, and the mechanical hand that was twice its size was knocked back. Then, it swung the Heat Fusion Chainsword and swept across the battlefield.

Hu!

The high temperature incandescent light swept across the battlefield, creating a large blank space. Regardless of friend or foe, countless mechanical soldiers were shredded into parts by the heavy Heat Fusion Chainsword.

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes. The Watcher Instrument turned into a large caliber floating cannon, and a blue light beam as thick as a water bucket shot out and hit the Ship Destroyer Giant Soldier's chest.

Hum!

A light yellow shield appeared and blocked this high-energy light beam. It exploded into light fragments, but the Ship Destroyer Giant Soldier's body was not harmed.

"He even brought out a Gundam. He's really going all out."

Han Xiao curled his lips. He was not surprised at all. He had been peeping every day for the past few days and had seen Carroll maintaining this Giant Soldier Mech.

The Class Advancement of the Mechanic class would also affect the result of the blueprint fusion. If he chose one of the branches, other than the Cutting-Edge Knowledge consumption of the other two branches being three times higher, there was another restriction, which was that the blueprints of the other two branches could not be fused.

Han Xiao chose Virtual Mechanic. When he gambled on blueprints, he could not get a part of the Heavy Mech style blueprints, such as the Ship Destroyer Giant Soldier Mech.

Carroll brought out the Giant Soldier Mech obviously not to deal with Han Xiao alone. It was like using a cannon to kill a mosquito.

His goal was to use the Giant Soldier Mech to quickly wipe out Black Star's Mech Legion.

Originally, he did not plan to use the Ship Destroyer as his trump card. However, the quality of Black Star's Mech Legion was beyond his expectations. His cannon fodder troops died too quickly, and the replacements could not keep up. If he did not bring out the Giant Soldier, Carroll was worried that he would lose control of the situation.

"Carroll has changed from defense to offense. I can feel the energy waves of this Giant Soldier Mech. It's very strong. Even if it's me, it will take a very long time to destroy it." Outside the shield, Malekith raised his voice and looked at Carroll in a new light.

Jaeger nodded. "That's more like it."

Far away in the palace, Heber looked at the live broadcast and nodded to express his approval.

At this time, a sudden change occurred on the battlefield!

All the mechanical soldiers on the battlefield suddenly stopped as if someone had pressed the freeze button.

Carroll's face was filled with shock. Just as he was about to control the Ship Destroyer to move, he realized that there was a static noise coming from the control panel. The artificial intelligence did not respond at all, and the nerve connection control directly failed.

The Ship Destroyer stood in place and did not move at all. It was like the entire battlefield was filled with machines.

The battlefield that was filled with gunfire suddenly became dead silent. The change was extremely sudden.

The sudden change caused the expressions of all the spectators to freeze.

Ding!

The Berserk Ape's Virtual Intrusion interface rang.

Han Xiao clenched his fists and chuckled.

His voice spread out, and it was extremely clear on the battlefield where a pin drop could be heard. Everyone could hear it.

"Alright, the foreplay is over."

Han Xiao knew that Carroll had the battlefield advantage, and he did not have the heart to fight a war of attrition. The reason he used the Mech Legion was to stall the enemy troops and give himself time to perform his Virtual Intrusion.

Now, with the support of Risda and Philip, the Virtual Intrusion was complete.

These standard machines were all controlled by the same artificial intelligence. After being hammered by Risda, they lost control directly. All the machines under Carroll's control were paralyzed and could only recover after the system rebooted.

Making use of this opportunity, Han Xiao walked toward the Ship Destroyer Colossal Soldier.

Dong dong dong …

As he walked forward, rows of mechanical soldiers fell. All of them had their systems malfunctioning, and the scene was magnificent. It was as if the people were bowing down to welcome their emperor!

Two words, awesome!

Han Xiao's path was unobstructed. This was the easiest time for him.

Virtual Mechanics were the best at internal conflicts. As the old saying went, 'without guns and cannons, the enemy will build them for us.'

Carroll looked at all his machines being destroyed by Han Xiao from the cockpit of the Ship Destroyer. His expression was extremely ugly, and he felt extremely humiliated.

As a Mechanic, when the machines in his hands were forcefully taken away by someone else, this feeling was indescribable. It was as if he had lost all his dignity.

"Quick, restart the system!" Carroll roared.

"Diagnosing … diagnosing malfunction and removing virus. Estimated time: unknown …" The system alarm echoed in the cockpit, bringing with it an ear-piercing noise.

"Sh * t, it's too late!" Carroll finally panicked when he saw Han Xiao approaching.

However, he still held on to his last shred of hope. In order to speed things up, Black Star had only used the most violent method to paralyze the Ship Destroyer's operating system. He did not take control of it, so he could still hide in the Ship Destroyer.

As long as Han Xiao could not destroy the Ship Destroyer's armor before the system rebooted, he would still have a chance to regain control of the situation.

However, the next moment, Carroll's heart sank to the bottom.

Han Xiao's Mech Legion all aimed at the Ship Destroyer. Endless bullets covered the sky, and the Ship Destroyer's high-energy shield only lasted two seconds under the terrifying firepower before shattering.

Boom!

The armor on its chest and abdomen was focused on and exploded. The Ship Destroyer could not withstand the force and fell to the ground face up.

The Buddha's Palm disintegrated and turned into more than ten mechanical hands. They turned into drills and drilled a hole in the Ship Destroyer's body.

Carroll's cockpit was exposed amidst the messy wires and energy pipes.

Due to the system's paralysis, Carroll could not even eject to escape. The Ship Destroyer had become his prison instead.

Looking at Han Xiao who jumped into the cockpit, Carroll's face was filled with fear. He hurriedly said, "I admit …"

Before he could finish, Han Xiao's large hand pinched his mouth like a pair of iron pliers, forcing Carroll's words back into his stomach.

"Go!"

Berserk Throw!

Dong!

Carroll was thrown out of the Ship Destroyer and flew into the sky. He flew up hundreds of meters and slammed into the dome of the training ground's protective shield.

He did not have a strong body. Although he was a Calamity Grade Super, his body's resistance was far inferior to that of a Pugilist. This collision caused him to feel dizzy, and he was inflicted with the [Dizzy] status of the Berserk Throw.

However, before he fell, Carroll's vision blurred, and Han Xiao flew below him in an instant.

The distance of a few hundred meters was just a matter of acceleration for the Berserk Ape mechanical suit, leaving behind a trail of blue flames.

Zap!

The next second, blinding lightning burst out from Han Xiao's body and illuminated Carroll's shocked expression.

His arms were like a bow that was pulled to the limit. Then, his fists landed heavily on Carroll's chest and pressed him against the dome of the protective shield.

Boom!

It was like a ball of lightning had exploded out of thin air.

Power Explosion!

Genetic Liberation!

Germinal Organization Leader Character Summon Card — Armor Piercing Combo!

Han Xiao did not hold back at all in this attack. With the triple enhancement, the power of this attack was raised to a terrifying level.

Boom!

An explosive sound wave swept out, and a circular shockwave burst out.

The power of this punch passed through Carroll's body and directly shattered the protective shield that covered the entire training ground!

In the sky full of light, Carroll shot up into the sky like a rocket, leaving rings of shockwaves behind.

Crimson blood splattered in the air.

All the Bloodshed Land spectators at the scene opened their mouths wide and looked up at Carroll, who was flying into the sky.

Malekith was stunned. In just ten seconds, Han Xiao had broken the battle of attrition and ended the battle.

Too fast!
